pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati aggāḷave cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.2: tena kho pana samayena upāsakā ārāmaṃ āgacchanti dhammassavanāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.3: dhamme bhāsite therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.4: navakā bhikkhū tattheva upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ upāsakehi saddhiṃ muṭṭhassatī asampajānā naggā vikujjamānā kākacchamānā seyyaṃ kappenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā naggā vikujjamānā kākacchamānā seyyaṃ kappessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ upāsakānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū anupasampannena saha seyyaṃ kappessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.10: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.11: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū anupasampannena saha seyyaṃ kappentīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.14: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā anupasampannena saha seyyaṃ kappessanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.17.1: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena saha seyyaṃ kappeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:1.18: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.1: athakho bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena kosambī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena kosambī tadavasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati badarikārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.4: bhagavatā āvuso rāhula sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ na anupasampannena saha seyyā kappetabbāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.6: athakho āyasmā rāhulo seyyaṃ alabhamāno vaccakuṭiyā seyyaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.7: athakho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena vaccakuṭī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā ukkāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.12: athakho āyasmā rāhulo bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.13: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.14: anujānāmi bhikkhave anupasampannena dvirattatirattaṃ saha seyyaṃ kappetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:2.16.1: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannena uttaridvirattatirattaṃ saha seyyaṃ kappeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.14: catutthe divase atthaṅgate suriye anupasampanne nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.1.15: bhikkhu nipanne anupasampanno nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.1: anupasampanne anupasampannasaññī uttaridvirattatirattaṃ saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.2: anupasampanne vematiko uttaridvirattatirattaṃ saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc5:3.2.3: anupasampanne upasampannasaññī uttaridvirattatirattaṃ saha seyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
